descriptionByLocale.it:
L'Emil Frey Group non è solo una famiglia svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automotive. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri principali dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sull'importazione di marchi di auto, il funzionamento di garage, la logistica di ricambio e accessori e la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey AG, Züri-Oberland Volketswil è il partner ufficiale di vendita e servizio delle esclusive marche BMW e MINI e garantisce fascino e gioia nella guida. I loro compiti
• Eseguire lavori di diagnostica, riparazione e manutenzione sui veicoli BMW & MINI
• Analisi e correzione di malfunzionamenti tecnici ed elettronici utilizzando moderni sistemi diagnostici
• Partecipazione attiva al business quotidiano
• Garantire il rispetto degli standard di qualità e sicurezza

• Esperienza approfondita nella diagnostica dei veicoli
• Metodo di lavoro analitico, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione
• Alto grado di responsabilità, affidabilità, impegno e determinazione
• Passione per l'industria automobilistica e la volontà di familiarizzare continuamente con le nuove tecnologie
• Buona conoscenza del tedesco, altre lingue benefiche
• Flessibile, resistente e dutiful

• Numerosi sconti (auto nuove e usate, lavoro di servizio e pezzi di ricambio, assicurazione veicolo e sanitaria, carte di carburante, hotel e molto altro ancora)
• Un fondo pensionistico autonomo, attraente e indipendente
• Una prospettiva di business a lungo termine
• Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo individuali

Crediamo che una forza lavoro diversificata e una cultura inclusiva ci permettano di realizzare il nostro pieno potenziale.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey AG, Züri-Oberland Volketswil is the official sales and service partner of the exclusive BMW and MINI brands and ensures fascination and joy in driving. Their tasks
• Carrying out diagnostic, repair and maintenance work on BMW & MINI vehicles
• Analysis and correction of technical and electronic malfunctions using modern diagnostic systems
• Active participation in day-to-day business
• Ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards
• Regular participation in brand-specific training and courses Your profile
• Completed vocational apprenticeship as an automotive mechatronics specialist EFZ as well as further training as an automotive diagnostician or currently in training
• In-depth experience in vehicle diagnostics
• Analytical, structured and solution-oriented working method
• High degree of responsibility, reliability, commitment and determination
• Passion for the automotive industry and willingness to continuously become familiar with new technologies
• Good knowledge of German, other languages beneficial
• Flexible, resilient and dutiful
• Category B driving licence What we offer you You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• An own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term business perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holiday As you can contact us Chiara Staccioli, Regional HR Manager is looking forward to the complete application (including CV, employment certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better legibility, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) is omitted. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. For us, diversity also means that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture allow us to realize our full potential.
• Carrying out diagnostic, repair and maintenance work on BMW & MINI vehicles
• Analysis and correction of technical and electronic malfunctions using modern diagnostic systems
• Active participation in day-to-day business
• Ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards
• Regular participation in brand-specific training and courses
• Completed vocational apprenticeship as an automotive mechatronics specialist EFZ as well as further training as an automotive diagnostician or currently in training
• In-depth experience in vehicle diagnostics
• Analytical, structured and solution-oriented working method
• High degree of responsibility, reliability, commitment and determination
• Passion for the automotive industry and willingness to continuously become familiar with new technologies
• Good knowledge of German, other languages beneficial
• Flexible, resilient and dutiful
• Category B driving licence

Siamo convinti che una squadra di lavoro variegata e una cultura integrativa ci permettano di sfruttare al meglio le nostre potenzialità.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG Biel is the official sales and/or service partner of the brands Subaru, Jaguar / Land Rover, Toyota, Kia, and Suzuki. We are looking for reinforcement for our team in Biel as of May 1, 2026 or by agreement. Your tasks
• You take care of the success-oriented and active sales of our broad model palette
• From the first contact, you care for our customers, advise them on the vehicle selection and the various financing and insurance options
• You ensure the successful delivery of the vehicle and the follow-up contact (especially customer satisfaction)
• The daily care of your existing customer base and the acquisition of new customers are part of your tasks, as well as the management and care of the vehicle park
• The care of our online appearance of the vehicles (announcement, photos, etc.)
• The help with events/exhibitions and the close cooperation with our departments (workshop, spare parts warehouse and customer service) is assumed Your profile
• Sales and consulting are fun for you
• You are a sales-oriented and strong negotiating personality and have already gained experience in sales and in the automotive industry (advantage)
• Your commercial flair, your customer and service orientation, and your communicative strength characterize you
• A high level of personal motivation, assertiveness, and passion for cars complete your profile
• You are fascinated by new technologies, trends, and IT and have a high level of flexibility and willingness to learn
• You speak at least two languages (DE and FR) and hold a category B driving license
• Your positive attitude enables you to easily integrate into a motivated and open team What we offer you
• You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Your own attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us Stefan Lanz, Administration Manager, looks forward to your complete application (e.g., curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For better readability, we have decided not to use the form of gender male, female, and diverse (m/w/d). Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work together in teams that, thanks to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

• Administration and support of voice and unified communications solutions

• Planning and implementation of system maintenance
• Participation in integration, migration and infrastructure projects
• Creating and maintaining technical documentation Your profile
• Completed training as an electrician, telematician, computer scientist, mediatologist or equivalent qualification
• Experience in operation as well as troubleshooting of telephony, communication or network infrastructures

What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family company with over 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. With 19 global brands under one roof, Emil Frey AG Autocenter Safenwil has the most diverse range of brands in the Mittelland region. Their tasks
• Preparatory work for the painting of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles
• Painting work (partial, whole or repainting work)
• Alternative repairs (spot repair) Your profile
• Successfully completed training as a carrosserie painter with several years of professional experience
• Very independent, efficient and careful work
• Organised and structured approach
• Knowledge of spinning technology is advantageous
• German mother tongue or very good knowledge of German
• Possession of the driving license Kat. B. What we offer you You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• An own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term business perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holiday
• Free parking
• As you can contact us Melanie Achini, Local HR Manager is looking forward to the complete application (e.g. CV, employment certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better legibility, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) is waived. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. For us, diversity also means that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture allow us to realize our full potential.

What to know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a family-run Swiss company with over 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and attention to the customer constitute the milestones of the company. Its activities focus on the importation of vehicle brands from all over the world, the management of workshops, the logistics of spare parts and accessories and the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey SA Noranco is official dealer of the sale and services of the Toyota, Lexus, Kia, Mitsubishi, Suzuki, Volvo, Jeep, Jaguar and Land Rover brands and has a warehouse spare parts and a body shop. His duties
• Coordination of everyday activities in collaboration with technical consultants ensuring the department an efficient workflow.
• Manage and coordinate the workshop team, promoting an efficient and collaborative work environment.
• Distribut the work to the mechanics according to skills, priorities and workload.
• Monitor the progress of the processes, ensuring compliance with agreed timing.
• Technical support for the workshop team for complex technical issues and diagnosis.
• Organize the daily activities of the workshop and optimize the use of personnel, equipment and resources.
• Check the quality of the work done and ensure compliance with company standards.
• Connect, follow and train apprentices, verifying their progress and skills.
• Manage any operational issues and intervene promptly to find solutions.
• Collaborate with management and other departments to ensure efficient workflow.
• Ensure compliance with safety standards, business procedures and quality standards. Your profile
• AFC Mechatronics Diploma, APF Diagnostic or APF Workshop Coordinator.
• Multiannual professional experience in a similar position in the automotive sector. Certification as Volvo Technician is a preferred title
• Experience in the management and coordination of a team of about 5–6 employees.
• Experience in training and supervision of apprentices.
• Good technical skills and ability to diagnose and resolve problems.
• Great organizational capacity and job planning.
• Ability to work independently, defining priorities and respecting timing.
• Good communication skills and collaboration with colleagues and other departments.
• Leadership, staff management and team motivation.
• Good knowledge of a second national language (German or French). We offer you a new challenge with exciting tasks and more:
• Numerous advantages (new and used cars, maintenance and spare parts for your car, car and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• Our attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term business perspective

To strengthen our Paid Media Team in Zurich Oerlikon, we are looking for a committed, technically-savvy and leadership-strong personality as Media Operations Lead Your tasks
• Ensuring the technically correct, high-quality and timely implementation of paid media campaigns
• Professional and disciplinary leadership as well as further development of the Media Operations Team
• Planning, prioritization and control of resources, tasks and operational processes
• Development, documentation and continuous optimization of processes, quality standards and technical specifications
• Responsibility for complex tracking, measurement and verification set-ups as well as their quality assurance
• Analysis and correction of technical errors and validation of measurement results and data quality
• Coordination of interfaces between campaign operations, ad operations, media planning, strategy & planning and external partners

• Experience in the management and development of employees as well as enjoyment of coaching and knowledge transfer

Pour des raisons de meilleure lisibilité, l'utilisation simultanée des formes de langue masculine, féminine et diversifiée (h/f/d) est supprimée. Les identités de sexe féminin et autres sont explicitement incluses. Pour nous, la diversité signifie aussi que les gens travaillent ensemble dans des équipes qui obtiennent les meilleurs résultats possibles grâce à leur unicité et leur diversité. Nous croyons qu'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et une culture inclusive nous permettent de réaliser notre plein potentiel.
• Assurer la mise en œuvre correcte, de qualité et en temps utile des campagnes médiatiques rémunérées

jobs.description:
Was Sie über uns wissen sollten Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit über 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Das Autohaus Zürich-Altstetten – mit seinem Standort am Hauptsitz der Emil Frey Gruppe – präsentiert die Modellpaletten von sieben Weltmarken sowie eine grosse Auswahl an Occasionen. Zum Betrieb gehören weiter die Markenwerkstätten, eine Carrosserieabteilung sowie ein Ersatzteillager. Zur Verstärkung unseres Ersatzteillagerteams suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine/n Detailhandelsfachmann/-frau Autoteile-Logistik oder eine/n Logistiker/-in mit Erfahrung in der Automobilbranche. Ihre Aufgaben
• Entgegennahme, Kontrolle und Einlagerung von Ersatzteilen, Zubehör sowie Rädern und Reifen
• Kommissionierung und Bereitstellung von Teilen für Werkstatt, Verkauf und externe Kunden
• Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Lagerbewirtschaftung und Durchführung von Umlagerungen
• Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen sowie Verkauf von Ersatzteilen und Zubehör am Schalter und per Telefon
• Beratung unserer internen und externen Kunden zu Produkten, Verfügbarkeit und Lieferterminen
• Verbuchung und Verrechnung von Ersatzteilaufträgen sowie Kontrolle der Lieferantenrechnungen
• Sicherstellung von Ordnung, Qualität und Effizienz im gesamten Ersatzteillager Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Detailhandelsfachmann EFZ (Fachrichtung Autoteile-Logistik) oder Logistiker EFZ mit Erfahrung in der Automobilbranche
• Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
• Selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsbewusstsein
• Freundliche, teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Kundenorientierung
• Belastbar, flexibel und motiviert, auch in hektischen Situationen den Überblick zu behalten Was wir Ihnen bieten Sie finden bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive

Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri principali dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sull'importazione di marchi di auto, il funzionamento di garage, la logistica di ricambio e accessori e la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey AG Münchenstein è il partner ufficiale di vendita e servizio dei marchi Ford, Jaguar, Land Rover e Bentley e offre anche una vasta gamma di veicoli di occasione di varie marche. descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family company with over 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey AG Münchenstein is the official sales and service partner of the Ford, Jaguar, Land Rover and Bentley brands and also offers a wide range of occasion vehicles from various brands. Their tasks
• First contact person for our customers in the service area
• Acceptance of repair and service contracts
• Competent advice on service and repair services
• Preparation of estimates and invoices
• Coordination and scheduling between customer and workshop
• Ensuring smooth running of day-to-day business
• Maintaining Customer Relationships and Active Customer Care Your Profile
• Completed technical training in the automotive sector (e.g. mechatronics specialist, automotive professional) or in the commercial sector with experience in the automotive sector
• Several years of experience in customer contact, ideally in the automotive industry
• Strong communication, organized and resilient
• High service and customer orientation
• You master German in style and negotiation, English at least at B1 level; good IT user knowledge
• Driving Licence Cat. B What we offer You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• An own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term business perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days holiday As you can contact us We look forward to the complete application (e.g. CV, employment certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better legibility, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) is waived. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. For us, diversity also means that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture allow us to realize our full potential.
• First contact person for our customers in the service area
• Acceptance of repair and service contracts
• Competent advice on service and repair services
• Preparation of estimates and invoices
• Coordination and scheduling between customer and workshop
• Ensuring smooth running of day-to-day business
• Maintaining customer relationships and active customer support
• Completed technical training in the automotive sector (e.g. mechatronics specialist, automotive professional) or in the commercial sector with experience in the automotive sector
• Several years of experience in customer contact, ideally in the automotive industry
• Strong communication, organized and resilient
• High service and customer orientation
• You master German in style and negotiation, English at least at B1 level; good IT user knowledge
• Driving licence Cat. B
descriptionByLocale.de:
Was Sie über uns wissen sollten Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit über 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey AG Münchenstein ist offizieller Verkaufs- und Servicepartner der Marken Ford, Jaguar, Land Rover und Bentley und bietet ausserdem eine grosse Auswahl an Occasionsfahrzeugen verschiedenster Marken. Ihre Aufgaben
• Erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden im Servicebereich
• Entgegennahme von Reparatur- und Serviceaufträgen
• Kompetente Beratung zu Service- und Reparaturleistungen
• Erstellung von Kostenvoranschlägen und Rechnungen
• Koordination und Terminplanung zwischen Kunden und Werkstatt
• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Ablaufs im Tagesgeschäft
• Pflege der Kundenbeziehungen und aktive Kundenbetreuung Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung in der Automobilbranche (z. B. Mechatroniker/-in, Automobil Fachmann/-frau) oder im kaufmännischen Bereich mit Erfahrung in der Automobilbranche
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt, idealerweise in der Automobilbranche
• Kommunikationsstark, organisiert und belastbar
• Hohe Dienstleistungs- und Kundenorientierung
• Deutsch beherrschen Sie stil- und verhandlungssicher, Englisch mindestens auf B1-Niveau; gute IT-Anwenderkenntnisse
• Führerausweis Kat. B Was wir Ihnen bieten Sie finden bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten
• Mindestens 25 Tage Ferien Wie Sie uns kontaktieren können Wir freuen uns auf die vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint. Diversität bedeutet für uns auch, dass Menschen in Teams zusammenarbeiten, die durch ihre Einzigartigkeit und Unterschiedlichkeit die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce que vous devriez savoir sur nous Le Groupe Emil Frey est non seulement une entreprise familiale suisse avec plus de 100 ans d'expérience, mais aussi l'une des principales entreprises de l'industrie automobile. Qualité, tradition, innovation et orientation client sont les principaux piliers de l'entreprise. Les activités sont axées sur l'importation de marques de voitures, l'exploitation de garages, la logistique de rechange et d'accessoires ainsi que la fourniture de services financiers. Emil Frey AG Münchenstein est le partenaire de vente et de service officiel des marques Ford, Jaguar, Land Rover et Bentley et propose également une large gamme de véhicules occasionnels de différentes marques. Leurs tâches
• Première personne de contact pour nos clients dans la zone de service
• Acceptation des contrats de réparation et de service
• Conseils compétents sur les services de service et de réparation
• Établissement des prévisions de dépenses et des factures
• Coordination et programmation entre le client et l'atelier
• Assurer le bon fonctionnement des activités quotidiennes
• Maintenir les relations avec la clientèle et le service actif de votre profil
• Formation technique complète dans le secteur automobile (par exemple, spécialiste en mécatronique, professionnel de l'automobile) ou dans le secteur commercial ayant une expérience dans le secteur automobile
• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans le contact client, idéalement dans l'industrie automobile
• Communication forte, organisée et résistante
• Service élevé et orientation client
• Vous maîtrisez l'allemand dans le style et la négociation, l'anglais au moins au niveau B1; bonne connaissance utilisateur informatique
• Permis de conduire Cat. B Ce que nous offrons Vous trouverez un nouveau défi avec des tâches passionnantes et beaucoup plus:
• De nombreuses réductions (automobiles neuves et d'occasion, travaux de service et pièces détachées, assurance véhicules et santé, cartes carburant, hôtels et bien plus encore)
• Un fonds de pension propre et attrayant en tant qu'institution de retraite indépendante
• Une perspective commerciale à long terme
• Possibilités individuelles de formation et de perfectionnement
• Au moins 25 jours de vacances Comme vous pouvez nous contacter Nous attendons avec impatience la demande complète (par exemple CV, certificats d'emploi, etc.) via le lien « Appliquer maintenant! ». Pour des raisons de meilleure lisibilité, l'utilisation simultanée des formes de langue masculine, féminine et diversifiée (h/f/d) est supprimée. Les identités de sexe féminin et autres sont explicitement incluses. Pour nous, la diversité signifie aussi que les gens travaillent ensemble dans des équipes qui obtiennent les meilleurs résultats possibles grâce à leur unicité et leur diversité. Nous croyons qu'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et une culture inclusive nous permettent de réaliser notre plein potentiel.

Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri principali dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sull'importazione di marchi di auto, il funzionamento di garage, la logistica di ricambio e accessori e la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey Digital AG fa parte del Gruppo Emil Frey ed è un fornitore di servizi di comunicazione completo per l'industria automobilistica e responsabile della digitalizzazione all'interno del Gruppo Emil Frey. MIPS (Marketing Information & Processing System) è una componente centrale dell'ecosistema di Gruppo e supporta processi di marketing e servizi digitali per importatori e rivenditori. Al fine di rafforzare il nostro team a Zurigo Oerlikon, stiamo cercando un Team Lead MIPS Operations immediatamente o con accordo. Si prende il controllo della gestione del Team Operazioni e garantire il funzionamento stabile, efficiente e orientato al cliente della piattaforma. I tuoi compiti
• Leadership e sviluppo del team MIPS: gestione professionale e del personale, definizione degli obiettivi, pianificazione delle risorse e delle capacità nonché coaching e ulteriore sviluppo dei dipendenti

L'Emil Frey Group non è solo una famiglia svizzera con oltre 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automotive. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i principali pilastri dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sull'importazione di marchi di auto, il funzionamento di garage, la logistica di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey Mobility AG è un centro di competenza per i servizi di mobilità integrata intorno alla vettura. Questo include l'assicurazione dei veicoli, ma anche le nostre società di finanziamento. Si può guardare avanti a questo: Hai un occhio per i dettagli, pensare in modo sicuro e apprezzare la responsabilità? Allora forma il futuro del finanziamento della mobilità con noi! Una posizione emozionante vi aspetta: non basta controllare le applicazioni, assicuratevi che le nostre transazioni di leasing siano effettuate in modo sicuro, efficiente e orientate al cliente.

• Condurre analisi di credito e di rischio legalmente conformi (GWG, KKG)
• Elaborazione di modifiche contrattuali come riscritture e rinnovi

• Si lavora strutturato, pensare analiticamente e tenere traccia anche sotto pressione del tempo.
• Comunichi chiaramente e professionalmente. In tedesco elegante, in francese molto buono, italiano è un plus.
• Siete orientati al cliente, in grado di lavorare di squadra e portare la volontà di sviluppare continuamente professionalmente. Oltre all'opportunità di modellare il futuro della mobilità e realizzare i sogni auto, offriamo ulteriori vantaggi:

• Con noi, ci si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro positivo basato sullo spirito di squadra e sul rispetto.
• Numerosi sconti (auto nuove e usate, lavori di servizio e pezzi di ricambio, assicurazione veicolo e sanitaria, carte di carburante, hotel e molto altro ancora)
• Un fondo pensionistico autonomo, attraente e indipendente

Was Du über uns wissen solltest Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit über 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey Digital AG gehört zur Emil Frey Gruppe und ist eine Full Service Kommunikations-Dienstleisterin für die Automobilbranche sowie verantwortlich für die Digitalisierung innerhalb der Emil Frey Gruppe. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Zürich Oerlikon suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Customer Service Manager/in Deine Aufgaben
• Professionelle Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen per Telefon, E-Mail und weiteren digitalen Kanälen auf Deutsch und Französisch
• Aufnahme, Qualifizierung und Dokumentation der Anfragen (z.B. in JIRA)
• Unterstützung der Kund:innen bei der Analyse und Lösung von Problemen im Zusammenhang mit unseren technischen Produkten und Dienstleistungen
• Koordination von Rückmeldungen und Nachverfolgung bis zur sauberen Fallabschliessung
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Implementierung, Academy und Entwicklung bei komplexeren Fällen
• Sicherstellung einer effizienten, transparenten Kommunikation zwischen Kund:innen und internen Abteilungen
• Weitergeben von wiederkehrenden Themen und Verbesserungspotenzialen an die zuständigen Stellen (Produkt, Projekt, Academy etc.) Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Erste Berufserfahrung im Kundendienst / Customer Service oder in einer ähnlichen Funktion von Vorteil
• Grundverständnis für technische Produkte oder SaaS-Lösungen; Bereitschaft, sich in unsere Lösungen (INSiDE, Carmarket) einzuarbeiten
• Teamorientierte, flexible Arbeitsweise und hohe Dienstleistungsorientierung
• Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Kund:innen, auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen
• Sorgfältige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und gutes Zeitmanagement
• Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für Fälle zu übernehmen und diese aktiv zum Abschluss zu bringen
• JIRA-Grundkenntnisse oder Erfahrung mit ähnlichen Ticketing-Systemen von Vorteil
• Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, mündlich wie schriftlich: sehr gute Deutsch- und Französischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift ein Must; jede weitere Sprache von Vorteil Was wir Dir bieten Du findest bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten

Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'Emil Frey Group non è solo una famiglia svizzera con oltre 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automotive. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i principali pilastri dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sull'importazione di marchi di auto, il funzionamento di garage, la logistica di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey Digital AG fa parte del Gruppo Emil Frey ed è un fornitore di servizi di comunicazione completo per l'industria automobilistica e responsabile della digitalizzazione all'interno del Gruppo Emil Frey. Per rafforzare il nostro team a Zurigo Oerlikon, stiamo cercando un Customer Service Manager immediatamente o con accordo.

• Registrazione, qualificazione e documentazione delle richieste (ad esempio in JIRA)
• Supporto per i clienti: nell'analisi e nella soluzione dei problemi legati ai nostri prodotti e servizi tecnici

• La comprensione di base dei prodotti tecnici o delle soluzioni SaaS; la volontà di familiarizzare con le nostre soluzioni (INSiDE, Carmarket)
• Metodo di lavoro flessibile e orientato al team e orientamento ad alto servizio
• Alta competenza sociale e fruizione del contatto diretto con i clienti: dentro, anche in situazioni difficili
• Lavoro attento, strutturato e buona gestione del tempo

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family company with over 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey Digital AG is part of the Emil Frey Group and is a full-service communications service provider for the automotive industry and responsible for digitalization within the Emil Frey Group. To strengthen our team in Zurich Oerlikon, we are looking for a Customer Service Manager immediately or by agreement.
• Professional processing of customer inquiries by telephone, e-mail and other digital channels in German and French
• Recording, qualification and documentation of requests (e.g. in JIRA)
• Support for customers: in the analysis and solution of problems related to our technical products and services
• Coordination of feedback and follow-up until clean case closure
• Close collaboration with product management, implementation, academy and development in more complex cases
• Ensuring efficient, transparent communication between customers: internal departments
• Passing on recurring topics and potential for improvement to the responsible bodies (product, project, academy, etc.) Your profile
• Commercial education or equivalent qualification completed
• First professional experience in customer service / customer service or in a similar function beneficial
• Basic understanding of technical products or SaaS solutions; Willingness to familiarize yourself with our solutions (INSiDE, Carmarket)
• Team-oriented, flexible working method and high service orientation
• High social competence and enjoyment of direct contact with customers: inside, even in demanding situations
• Careful, structured work and good time management
• Willingness to take responsibility for cases and actively bring them to a conclusion
• JIRA basic knowledge or experience with similar ticketing systems
• Strong communication skills, both oral and written: very good knowledge of German and French in words and writing a must; every other language of advantage What we offer You will find a new challenge with us with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• An own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term business perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us We look forward to the full application (e.g. CV, employment certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better readability, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) is waived. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. For us, diversity also means that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to realize our full potential.

jobs.title: Head of IT Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Was Du über uns wissen solltest Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit über 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey IT Solutions AG erbringt für die Emil Frey Gruppe verschiedene, zentrale ICT-Dienstleistungen und verwaltet die Server-Backend Systeme in zwei Datacenters zusammen mit der Hybrid-Cloud Infrastruktur für ca. 10'000 User, welche an über 100 Standorten in Europa arbeiten. Gestalte eine sichere, stabile und zukunftsfähige IT-Infrastruktur für unsere international tätige Unternehmensgruppe als Head of IT Infrastructure . In dieser wichtigen Schlüsselrolle führst du den Infrastruktur-Bereich mit sechs Teams, stellst den zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher und entwickelst Architektur, Technologien und Services strategisch weiter. Du verbindest operative Exzellenz mit klarer Governance, Compliance und konsequenter Transformation. Deine Aufgaben
• Fachliche und personelle Führung des gesamten Infrastruktur-Bereichs mit sechs Teams sowie die Förderung einer aktiven, transparenten Zusammenarbeit
• Sicherstellung eines stabilen, sicheren und hochverfügbaren Infrastruktur-Betriebs sowie einer professionellen Serviceerbringung
• Verantwortung für die Infrastruktur-Architektur und fundierte Technologieentscheidungen über den gesamten Lebenszyklus
• Strategische Planung und Weiterentwicklung der Bereiche Netzwerk, Endpoint & Server, Storage und Cloud-Systeme
• Initiierung und Steuerung von Infrastruktur-, Konsolidierungs- und Transformationsprojekten, beispielsweise im Rechenzentrums- und Cloud-Umfeld
• Steuerung externer Lieferanten und Partner zur Sicherung einer verlässlichen, wirtschaftlichen Leistungserbringung
• Planung und Begleitung der jährlichen Audits durch die externe Revision sowie Gewährleistung aller IT-Compliance-, Betriebssicherheits- und regulatorischen Anforderungen
• Steuerung der Budget- und Ressourcenplanung inklusive der bedarfsgerechten Priorisierung von Vorhaben
• Erarbeitung, Weiterentwicklung und Überwachung von IT-Sicherheitsrichtlinien und IT-Prozessen, einschliesslich des Internen Kontrollsystems (IKS)
• Aktive Unterstützung deiner Teams bei anspruchsvollen operativen und konzeptionellen Fragestellungen Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossenes Studium in der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung

• Unternehmerisches Denken, hohe Kundenorientierung sowie Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv und pragmatisch voranzutreiben

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'Emil Frey Group non è solo una famiglia svizzera con oltre 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automotive. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i principali pilastri dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sull'importazione di marchi di auto, il funzionamento di garage, la logistica di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG fornisce vari servizi ICT centrali per il Gruppo Emil Frey e gestisce i sistemi di backend server in due data center insieme all'infrastruttura cloud ibrida per ca. 10.000 utenti che lavorano in oltre 100 sedi in Europa. Progettare un'infrastruttura IT sicura, stabile e sostenibile per il nostro gruppo di aziende attivo a livello internazionale come responsabile delle infrastrutture IT. In questo ruolo chiave, guiderai la divisione infrastrutture con sei team, garantirai operazioni affidabili e svilupperai strategicamente architettura, tecnologie e servizi. Unisci l'eccellenza operativa con una chiara governance, conformità e una trasformazione coerente. I tuoi compiti
• Gestione professionale e umana dell'intera area infrastrutturale con sei team e promozione della cooperazione attiva e trasparente
• Garantire operazioni infrastrutturali stabili, sicure e altamente disponibili e fornitura di servizi professionali
• Responsabilità per l'architettura delle infrastrutture e le decisioni tecnologiche informate sull'intero ciclo di vita
• Pianificazione strategica e ulteriore sviluppo dei sistemi di rete, endpoint & server, storage e cloud
• Iniziazione e controllo di progetti infrastrutturali, di consolidamento e di trasformazione, ad esempio nel data center e nell'ambiente cloud
• Controllo dei fornitori esterni e dei partner per garantire un servizio affidabile ed economico
• Pianificazione e sostegno degli audit annuali da parte dell'audit esterno, nonché garantire tutti i requisiti di conformità IT, sicurezza operativa e normativa
• Controllo del bilancio e della pianificazione delle risorse, compresa la priorità basata sulle esigenze dei progetti
• Sviluppo, sviluppo e monitoraggio delle politiche e dei processi di sicurezza IT, incluso il sistema di controllo interno (ICS)
• Supporto attivo dei tuoi team in problematiche operative e concettuali
• Studi completi in informatica, informatica aziendale o una formazione tecnica comparabile
• Diversi anni di leadership e esperienza di gestione in un'organizzazione di infrastrutture IT esigente, idealmente con diversi team specializzati
• Conoscenza approfondita nelle aree di rete, luogo di lavoro / endpoint, server, archiviazione, data center e infrastruttura cloud
• Esperienza dimostrabile nelle decisioni di architettura, tecnologia e ciclo di vita delle infrastrutture e nell'attuazione di complessi progetti di trasformazione

Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey IT Solutions AG provides various central ICT services for the Emil Frey Group and manages the server backend systems in two data centers together with the hybrid cloud infrastructure for approx. 10,000 users who work at over 100 locations in Europe. Design a secure, stable and sustainable IT infrastructure for our internationally active group of companies as Head of IT Infrastructure. In this key role, you will lead the infrastructure division with six teams, ensure reliable operations and strategically develop architecture, technologies and services. You combine operational excellence with clear governance, compliance and consistent transformation. Your tasks
• Professional and human management of the entire infrastructure area with six teams as well as the promotion of active, transparent cooperation
• Ensuring stable, secure and highly available infrastructure operations and professional service provision
• Responsibility for infrastructure architecture and informed technology decisions over the entire life cycle
